name: Omanaga
author: Jeremiah Johnston
description: Configure the Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed (this mouse only, on its USB dongle): button mapping, Hypershift, DPI, polling rate and sleep, saved on the mouse, no OpenRazer. Macros and lighting are not supported.

barWidget.description: Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed only: buttons, DPI, polling and sleep. No macros or lighting.
